intro.en: A chat client needs four things: the project endpoint, a credential, the deployment name and a loop that keeps the conversation.
intro.ro: Chat client ko chaar cheezein chahiye: project endpoint, credential, deployment ka naam aur guftagu rakhne wala loop.

text.en: Finds your identity: az login on a laptop, managed identity in Azure. No key in the code.
text.ro: Aap ki identity dhoondta hai: laptop par az login, Azure mein managed identity. Code mein key nahi.

text.en: Returns an OpenAI client that is already authenticated for the project.
text.ro: OpenAI client deta hai jo project ke liye pehle se authenticated hota hai.

text.en: input + instructions; result in output_text; previous_response_id continues on the server.
text.ro: input + instructions; nateeja output_text mein; previous_response_id server par guftagu jari rakhta hai.

text.en: List of messages with roles; result in choices[0].message.content; you send the history.
text.ro: Roles wale messages ki list; nateeja choices[0].message.content mein; history aap bhejte hain.

text.en: stream=True delivers pieces while the model writes, so waiting feels shorter.
text.ro: stream=True model ke likhte waqt tukre deta hai, is liye intezar kam lagta hai.

text.en: For 429 and temporary 5xx errors wait longer after each try; fix 401, 403 and 404 in code or settings.
text.ro: 429 aur waqti 5xx errors par har dafa zyada intezar; 401, 403 aur 404 code ya settings mein theek karein.

text.en: Ten lines are enough. The second call knows the first one because of previous_response_id.
text.ro: Das lines kaafi hain. Doosri call previous_response_id ki wajah se pehli ko janti hai.

example.code:
from azure.ai.projects import AIProjectClient
from azure.identity import DefaultAzureCredential

project = AIProjectClient(endpoint=ENDPOINT, credential=DefaultAzureCredential())
openai = project.get_openai_client()
first = openai.responses.create(
    model="chat-prod", instructions="Answer briefly.", input="What is a token?")
print(first.output_text)
next_one = openai.responses.create(
    model="chat-prod", input="Give an example.", previous_response_id=first.id)
print(next_one.output_text)

remember.en: model = deployment name in both APIs.
remember.ro: Dono APIs mein model = deployment ka naam.

remember.en: Read endpoints from environment variables; never hard-code keys.
remember.ro: Endpoints environment variables se parhein; keys kabhi code mein na likhein.

remember.en: All tokens count: instructions, history, input and output.
remember.ro: Tamam tokens gine jate hain: instructions, history, input aur output.

traps.en: The project endpoint and the Azure OpenAI endpoint are different addresses.
traps.ro: Project endpoint aur Azure OpenAI endpoint alag pate hain.

traps.en: Append the reply with the assistant role, not as a user message.
traps.ro: Jawab ko assistant role ke saath append karein, user message ki tarah nahi.
